links.outcome: 12-month maternal anxiety (GAD-7) and depression (PHQ-9) scores, chatbot vs active control in randomized trial
links.effect: No difference in anxiety (adjusted mean difference 0.10; 95% CI -0.77 to 0.96) or depression (-0.23; 95% CI -1.05 to 0.59), nor in ED visits, postpartum care, contraception, or sleep.
links.quote: The AI chatbot was not associated with differences in anxiety scores (adjusted mean difference, 0.10; 95% CI, -0.77 to 0.96) or depression scores (adjusted mean difference, -0.23; 95% CI, -1.05 to 0.59), nor with emergency department visits, postpartum care, contraception use, or sleep duration.

screen.reason: This is a randomized clinical trial assessing the clinical efficacy/safety of deploying a generative AI chatbot directly to pregnant and postpartum individuals compared to an active control, rather than testing a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
